# `aitbc blockchain monitor`

Monitor chain activity in real time or export snapshots.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc blockchain monitor [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--chain-id` | text | — | yes | The Chain id. |
| `--realtime` | flag | `false` | no | Real-time monitoring |
| `--export` | text | — | no | Export monitoring data to file |
| `--interval` | integer | `5` | no | Update interval in seconds |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc blockchain monitor --chain-id <chain_id>
```
